people.name: Barak
people.line: An Israelite commander who defeated Canaanite forces with Deborah.

people.name: Deborah
people.line: Prophetess and judge who led Israel to victory over Canaanites.

people.name: Issachar
people.line: Son of Jacob and Leah, forefather of tribe

people.name: Reuben
people.line: Firstborn son of Jacob and Leah

translations.web: The princes of Issachar were with Deborah. As was Issachar, so was Barak. They rushed into the valley at his feet. By the watercourses of Reuben, there were great resolves of heart.
translations.bsb: The princes of Issachar were with Deborah, and Issachar was with Barak, rushing into the valley at his heels. In the clans of Reuben there was great indecision.
translations.kjv: And the princes of Issachar were with Deborah; even Issachar, and also Barak: he was sent on foot into the valley. For the divisions of Reuben there were great thoughts of heart.
translations.asv: And the princes of Issachar were with Deborah; As was Issachar, so was Barak; Into the valley they rushed forth at his feet. By the watercourses of Reuben There were great resolves of heart.
